agencyEn: Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change (MoEFCC)
agencyZh: 环境、森林与气候变化部
descriptionZh: 印度环境部负责生态保护和气候政策，管理广袤的森林资源和生物多样性。
descriptionEn: India's MoEFCC is responsible for ecological protection and climate policy, managing vast forest resources and biodiversity.

parisAgreement.ndcTargetZh: 2030年GDP碳强度比2005年降低45%；非化石能源装机达500GW
parisAgreement.ndcTargetEn: Reduce GDP carbon intensity 45% vs 2005 by 2030; 500GW non-fossil capacity
parisAgreement.ndc3Target: 47% GDP emissions-intensity reduction by 2035 vs. 2005; ~60% non-fossil installed power capacity

montrealProtocol.commitmentZh: 已完全淘汰CFCs等受控物质；2023年批准基加利修正案，2047年前削减HFCs 85%
montrealProtocol.commitmentEn: Fully phased out CFCs; Kigali Amendment ratified 2023, 85% HFC reduction by 2047

cbd.commitmentZh: 承诺2030年保护30%陆地和海洋；拥有全球最丰富的生物多样性之一
cbd.commitmentEn: Committed to 30x30 target; one of the most biodiverse nations

carbonPricing.noteZh: 煤炭税（GST补偿税）约400卢比/吨；碳信用交易制度筹备中
carbonPricing.noteEn: Coal cess (GST compensation) ~₹400/t; carbon credit trading scheme under development

desertification.commitmentZh: 目标到 2030 修复 2600 万公顷退化土地；2019 COP14 主办国。
desertification.commitmentEn: Target to restore 26M hectares of degraded land by 2030; hosted COP14 (2019).
